name: Westlake Plaza and Center
demographics: Westlake Plaza and Center serves the affluent Westlake Village community, attracting primarily upper-middle-class families and professionals with household incomes significantly above the national average. The trade area draws residents from nearby Thousand Oaks and Agoura Hills, with a demographic mix skewing toward families with children, active retirees, and dual-income households aged 35-65. Shoppers here prioritize convenience and quality, seeking everyday necessities alongside specialty retail and dining options in an upscale suburban setting.
description: Westlake Plaza and Center is a well-established shopping destination located along South Westlake Boulevard in the heart of Westlake Village, California. This community-oriented retail center serves the affluent residents of Westlake Village and surrounding communities in the Conejo Valley, offering a convenient mix of shopping, dining, and services. The center maintains a strong reputation with a 4.5-star rating from over 1,300 reviews, reflecting its popularity among local shoppers who appreciate its accessible location and quality tenant mix. Open daily from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM, Westlake Plaza and Center provides extended hours to accommodate the busy schedules of its professional and family-oriented customer base. The shopping center embodies the upscale suburban character of Westlake Village, delivering a comfortable and convenient retail experience that has made it a staple in this desirable Southern California community.
summary: Westlake Plaza and Center is a popular community shopping destination in upscale Westlake Village, serving local residents with convenient retail, dining, and service options. With a 4.5-star rating and extended daily hours, this well-regarded center provides an accessible shopping experience in one of Southern California's most desirable suburban communities.
